project.title: Grass Touching Simulator
project.description: A cozy incremental clicker about touching grass. The player clicks top-down grass tiles, earns Grass Touches, unlocks skills, buys seed shop systems, and gradually expands the field.

handoff.note: Created at the end of a long context window so a fresh Codex session can continue without losing project memory.

currentStatus.lastCommit: ab16c58 Expand skill tree and seed shop systems
currentStatus.worktreeAtHandoff: Clean before creating this handoff file

featuresImplemented: Title screen inspired by the provided pixel-art mockup.
Top-down clicker field with grass tiles that disappear when touched and regrow afterward.
Organic field spread from milestones instead of sterile 1-to-9 square expansion.
Grass Touches resource and lifetime touch tracking.
Separate skill tree screen with hover information boxes and clickable upgrade nodes.
Skill tree branches for touch power, regrowth, crits, nature/dew, rare grass, and late-game Grassmaxxing.
Separate seed shop screen with unlockable systems.
Seed shop items including Seed Pouch, Sprinkler, Wild Spread, Field Journal, Weather Jar, Compost Bin, and Bug Hotel.
Weather system unlocked by Weather Jar, with rotating effects like Dewy Morning, Warm Sunlight, Lucky Breeze, and Seed Wind.
Critical touches with stronger pop text and audio feedback.
Double-touch chance and instant-regrow chance as new upgrade mechanics.
Progressive grass tiers that appear randomly later and give extra touches.
Rare grass scaling through skills and shop items.
Grass tile art upgraded using generated grass assets.
Sound effects for touching grass and crits.
Credits menu includes Cosmodeus and Remy as playtesters.
Mobile/responsive fixes for smaller screens and orientation changes.
Reset save button made smaller and moved to the bottom right.

designDirection.tone: Cozy, silly, meme-aware, satisfying, and increasingly absurd.
designDirection.coreFeelGoal: Clicking grass should feel juicy: good sound, good pop text, good visual feedback, and enough randomness to keep the player wanting one more touch.
userPreferences: Organic field expansion, not perfect square growth.
Skill tree instead of a plain upgrade shop.
Seed shop should unlock new mechanics rather than duplicate the skill tree.
Grassmaxxing is a favored late-game concept.

recentContentPass.summary: Expanded the game beyond raw clicking by adding a larger skill tree, seed shop progression, rare grass modifiers, and weather.
newSkillConcepts: Two-Handed Technique: chance for touches to count twice.
Mindful Contact: chance for touched patches to instantly regrow.
Satisfying Crunch: crit and seed drop improvements.
Root Network: faster regrowth and instant regrow chance.
Perennial Patches: stronger instant regrow chance.
Dew Respecter: more dew and more seeds.
Grass Identification: rare grass appears more often.
Better Eyes: rare grass is worth more.
Clover Magnet: rare grass and crits become more common.
Premium Pasture: stronger rare grass progression.
newShopConcepts: Field Journal: rare grass appears slightly more often.
Compost Bin: improves seed drops and rare grass value.
Bug Hotel: nudges crits and seeds upward.

knownIssuesAndRisks: Skill tree is getting dense. It may need pan/zoom or pages soon.
Seed shop scroll exists but has no visible scrollbar yet.
Weather announcements may be subtle because the main HUD refreshes often.
Phaser makes the production bundle large; Vite warns about chunks over 500 kB. This is expected for now.
Balance is prototype-level. Costs, unlock timing, and multipliers likely need tuning after playtesting.
Need continued phone testing, especially landscape/portrait transitions on Samsung Z Flip 7.

recommendedNextSteps.task: Playtest the new progression from a fresh save.
recommendedNextSteps.details: Check whether seeds, Weather Jar, rare grass, crits, and Grassmaxxing unlock at satisfying times.
Add pan/drag and maybe zoom, or split the tree into tabs like Touch, Growth, Nature, Crits, and Weird.
Seeds should unlock new mechanics such as tools, zones, passive creatures, rituals, weather upgrades, or automation.
Layer touch sound variations, crit bass hits, grass sway, tiny particle bursts, screen pulse, and better rare grass pop text.

recommendedNextSteps.task: Add field biomes or surface evolution.
recommendedNextSteps.details: Let milestones change the surrounding field from lonely patch to yard, meadow, park, nature reserve, sacred lawn, and cursed internet detox zone.
Add funny upgrade names around touching grass, logging off, going outside, dew, lawn lore, soil, sandals, sunlight, pollen, and wholesome brain healing.
Eventually wrap the web game with Electron or Tauri, add local save/export, settings, achievements, full-screen handling, and Steamworks integration.

skillTreeBranches: Touch: softer hands, palm slap, two-handed technique, sensory overload, grassmaxxing.
Growth: roots, compost, sunlight, perennials, lawn memory.
Nature: dew, weather watching, insects, pollen, wildflowers, biodiversity.
Crits: lucky clover, dramatic touch, overreaction, forbidden tickle, jackpot patch.
Automation: sprinkler, rake, lawn whisperer, passive breeze, community park visitors.
Weird: logging off, terminally online detox, outside aura, suspiciously sentient lawn.
seedShopSystems: Tool Shed: unlock tools that change how tiles are touched.
Weather Station: reroll or extend weather.
Compost Ritual: sacrifice seeds for temporary growth boosts.
Bug Sanctuary: passive crit or seed effects.
Picnic Blanket: idle rewards while away.
Garden Gnome: strange upgrades with strong benefits and weird downsides.
Map Expansion: unlock new field shapes or special zones.
